verdicts.reason: Both candidates are almost identical, and both have the same faults. The translucent vertical panel behind the text is gone, so the black subhead and arrows sit straight on the busy city photo and are hard to read. The two arrow sets (<<< and >>>), which framed the copy in the original, are run together into one confusing row of chevrons over the image. The headline block crowds the top-left edge while the lower half is just photo. A gets the nod because its subhead sits about halfway between the headline and the arrows; in B the subhead is pushed up toward 'London', leaving a larger, uneven gap above the arrows.
